# Taylor & Francis

> > A comprehensive academic digital library providing curated ebook collections, reference works, and primary sources across humanities, social sciences, and professional disciplines.

Taylor & Francis is a leading academic publisher offering extensive digital collections including historical references, literature archives, and subject-specific resources. The platform serves researchers, students, and institutions with searchable primary sources and scholarly materials spanning multiple centuries and disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Academic Publishing
- Digital Library
- Reference Works
- Primary Sources
- 19th Century British History

## Core Collections

- [Taylor & Francis eBooks, Reference Works and Collections](https://www.taylorfrancis.com): Homepage showcasing ebook collections across academic subjects including humanities, social sciences, engineering, technology, and medicine

## Historical & Literary Collections

- [19th Century British Society](https://www.taylorfrancis.com/british-society): Comprehensive reference work covering 19th Century British Society (1789-1914) with primary sources and historical documentation
- [Romanticism](https://www.taylorfrancis.com/romanticism): Romanticism collection covering British and Irish literature from 1760-1830 with searchable resources and literary analysis

## Global Development Resources

- [Sustainable Development Goals Online](https://taylorfrancis.com/sdgo): UN Sustainable Development Goals curated library supporting global development initiatives and research
